decision: 44 fewer loads and lower estimated cost did not produce a repeatable runtime improvement. Median paired ratios were 1.094,1.075,0.996. Heavy shared-host load prevents a precise regression claim, but the candidate fails the runtime acceptance criterion. Keep the previous shipping body, archive the proposal, retain the independently discovered verifier soundness fix.

The archive contains only the optimizer proposal/tests, not the verifier fix, and applies to the retained fixed production code.

verification.found_bug: zeroExtend formerly widened a parameter truncated below its original declaration without retaining its mask; this could falsely prove identity for a W write under a u64 source contract. Fixed independently, cached verdict namespace invalidated. Explicit conversion mask fusion preserves the unchanged Lean rendering pins; no Lean theorem changed.
